## Summary

Rylen Anil works across cybersecurity, responsible disclosure, cloud security, full-stack development, artificial intelligence, Linux tooling, ESP32 hardware, and student-focused technology projects.

## Notable public work

- JEE Advanced 2026 candidate/result infrastructure disclosure: public Google Cloud Storage misconfiguration exposing result and admit-card files.
- Bucky: ESP32 Bluetooth HID security research project.
- Counseltron: AI-powered virtual counselor for students.
- whisperPairForBruce: audio/context pairing project for Bruce devices.
- SSH Desk: full interactive remote desktop delivered through one SSH session in the terminal.
- configTimeMachine: configuration-file history and rollback utility.
- Elliot: AI Linux terminal assistant.
